# PatrolTech

> PatrolTech is guard tour and security patrol software developed by Ingenieros Web SL in Madrid, Spain. It combines QR/NFC checkpoint recording, offline patrol records, incident reports and a management dashboard. The product was founded in 2024.

## Product and usage

- [Official English website](https://patroltech.online/en): product overview and contact.
- [Sitio oficial en español](https://patroltech.online): control de rondas de vigilancia.
- [Pricing](https://patroltech.online/en/pricing): current plan details; the free plan covers five checkpoints.
- [Tutorials](https://patroltech.online/en/tutorials): official product walkthroughs.
- [English video demonstration](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=quDciuAcAV0): patrol app and dashboard walkthrough.

## Integrations

The public repositories for the PatrolTech REST API, TypeScript SDK and MCP are available to everyone. Code and documentation are being uploaded by the implementation team.

- [API and SDK repository](https://github.com/PatrolTech/api-sdk): REST integration and TypeScript SDK resources.
- [MCP repository](https://github.com/PatrolTech/mcp-server): Model Context Protocol integration for compatible AI assistants.

## Contact and terminology

Business contact: info@patroltech.app.
PatrolTech, Patrol Tech and PatrolTech Online refer here to the PatrolTech product by Ingenieros Web SL.
A checkpoint visit records an event in the field; synchronization happens later when an offline device reconnects.
The management apps linked in the profile are for managers. Officers use the separate patrol recording app.
This repository contains marketing and brand resources. Product code and integration documentation are maintained in the linked integration repositories.

## Field-test resources

- [Editable guard tour field-test kit](https://github.com/PatrolTech/.github/blob/main/06-guard-tour-field-test-kit.md): a proposed 15-minute evaluation exercise with an evidence sheet and links to existing templates. Published by PatrolTech / Ingenieros Web SL.
- [Illustrated field-test PDF](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PatrolTech/.github/main/07-guard-tour-field-test.pdf): seven slides with official demonstration images and clickable resource links.
- [Complete field-test guide](https://patroltech.hashnode.dev/the-15-minute-guard-tour-acceptance-test-keep-the-evidence-not-just-a-green-tick): original article explaining the exercise.

The linked template and content sites are part of PatrolTech's content network. The exercise is not a certification or a report of a completed product test.
